limitations: Validation domains select SAPF settings; their calibrated scores are not unbiased holdout results.
Quality screening conditions on complete full-trace masks.
The same historical Google release has been studied before; no claim of a newly collected untouched dataset.
3d test windows overlap; cross-domain holdout is not independent-site generalization.
Eagle is reserved as a final holdout and is not loaded.
